speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) what surveys or research are currently undertaken to assess the job impact of training courses that are supported by Government funds; (b) whether the Government will publish the findings of such studies; and (c) whether the Government will consider extending funding support to trainers based on the outcome of the studies.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
text: This is a useful dimension because not all training necessarily leads to an immediate wage increase.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Training benefits workers, who are otherwise at risk of displacement, to stay employable and to keep their jobs.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
text: SSG is continually enhancing its methods of assessment and evaluation of outcomes of training courses.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
text: This is to enable us to better channel our subsidies to courses that deliver manpower development outcomes for Singaporeans.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: End of question time, The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the Day.

speaker: Mr Speaker
